advancements.artificers_armory.parent.de: Forge magical weapons to take on the world.
advancements.artificers_armory.firebrand: Use a Firebrand to shoot a fireball that can damage and set enemies aflame.
advancements.artificers_armory.censer_us: Use a Censer to disperse a cloud of incense that can contain a potion effect if assigned by using the censer with a potion in your other hand, and reset with a milk bucket.
advancements.artificers_armory.blight_us: Use a Blight to exhale a cloud of infectious plagued breath.
advancements.artificers_armory.spirit_ca: Raise an undead servant by holding a Spirit Candle in either hand, or by using it on the ground.
advancements.artificers_armory.nervous_m: Bring your undead servants near an Iron Golem, it would be really funny.
advancements.artificers_armory.chime_sum: You've Got A Friend In Me
Summon a familiar spirit by ringing a Chime.
advancements.artificers_armory.protector: Summon a familiar spirit with the Protector Enchantment.
advancements.artificers_armory.healer_su: Summon a familiar spirit with the Healer Enchantment.
advancements.artificers_armory.prankster: Summon a familiar spirit with the Prankster Enchantment.
advancements.artificers_armory.bruiser_s: Summon a familiar spirit with the Bruiser Enchantment.
jei.artificers_armory.firebrand_info: A weapon that will shed light like a torch when held in either hand. When used, it can shoot a fireball that can damage and set enemies aflame. Fireballs can also destroy certain blocks like Cobweb, Snow, and normal Ice. Certain Firebrands, or Firebrands with the Soul Blaze enchantment, can damage normally fireproof targets and inflict the Soul Burn effect, dealing damage over time similar to burning and increasing damage taken from being on fire. Can also be used identically to a flint and steel while crouching.
jei.artificers_armory.spirit_candle_info: A candle that allows the user to summon undead servants while it is in either hand. Will slowly summon servants while held, or can be used on the ground to immediately summon a servant, with a short cooldown. Continually use the item to boost the attack damage, movement speed, and damage resistance of your minions and slowly heal them, at the cost of durability. Crouch-Use the item while looking in the direction of an entity to mark it for your minions to prioritize as a target. All minions will vanish when a spirit candle is no longer in either of your hands.
jei.artificers_armory.chime_info: A magical bell that can summon a familiar spirit that takes the form of a golden allay. If used while your familiar is already present, it will apply a supportive effect to you and your allies. Your familiar will assist you in and out of combat, and you can direct it to pick up items or attack enemies by crouch-using the chime while looking at your target. Your familiar will pick up and hold onto items by default, and you can interact with them using the chime to instruct them to deposit items in containers or ignore them.
jei.artificers_armory.blight_info: A plague doctor's cane infused with a hex that allows its wielder to exhale a cloud of noxious breath that inflicts enemies with the Plague effect. You can crouch-use the blight to consume the plague from nearby enemies, recovering some health for each instance of it that you consume.
jei.artificers_armory.censer_info: A blessed flail that can be used to disperse clouds of incense. The incense will continually apply an effect to creatures within it. By default, the effect is a helpful blessing, but you can use the censer with a potion in your other hand to change the effect, or a milk bucket to restore the original effect. Helpful effects will only affect you and allies, and harmful effects will ignore you and allies.
message.artificers_armory.familiar_retri: %d will pick up dropped while idle.
message.artificers_armory.familiar_depos: %d will deposit dropped items in containers while idle.
tooltip.artificers_armory.hold_shift_enc: Hold shift for more enchantment information...
tooltip.artificers_armory.burn_time: Sets targets on fire for %d seconds
tooltip.artificers_armory.flamethrower_w: Fire Aspect / Flame - Effect activation happens faster.
tooltip.artificers_armory.charge_shot_co: Fire Aspect / Flame - Charge time reduced.
tooltip.artificers_armory.soul_blaze: Soul Blaze - Flames can affect normally fireproof enemies, and increase damage taken from being on fire.
enchantment.artificers_armory.charge_bla: Hold down the use button to charge an explosive projectile that can grow in size and power up to five times the base damage, and deal half damage to targets nearby the impact.
enchantment.artificers_armory.flamethrow: Hold down the use button to continuously blast a cone of flame in front of you, damaging targets and setting them on fire, at the cost of reduced base damage.
enchantment.artificers_armory.warming_li: Hold down the use button to cast a magical light in a wide area that heals yourself and your allies, and damages your enemies. However, base damage is greatly reduced, and only targets that are currently hostile to you will be damaged.
enchantment.artificers_armory.soul_blaze: Converts the fireballs of non-Soul Fire Firebrands to Soul Fire, and enhances the effect of Firebrands that are already Soul Fire.
tooltip.artificers_armory.sc_fortune: Fortune - Increases the likelihood of undead servants appearing with equipment and enchantments.
tooltip.artificers_armory.sc_infinity: Infinity - Undead servants summoned passively do not cause durability damage.
enchantment.artificers_armory.grim_harve: When you or your minions slay an enemy, has a chance of spawning a new minion if you are not at your maximum, or summoning a skeletal priest to empower your minions if you are.
enchantment.artificers_armory.hex.desc: When you mark a target for your minions to focus on by crouch-using the item in their direction, inflict it with a hex that reduces their attack damage, movement speed, and attack speed.
enchantment.artificers_armory.focus.desc: While you hold down the use button, provide your minions with a more powerful supportive effect, at the cost of slowly draining your hunger.
While you hold down the use button, slowly sap the life force of nearby targets to heal yourself.
enchantment.artificers_armory.phylactery: While you have three or more minions, or your maximum if it is lower than three, you can avoid lethal damage by draining the life force from all of your active minions. Consumes a portion of the item's durability and puts it on cooldown for a while.
tooltip.artificers_armory.censer_effect_: Censer could not accept one or more instant effects from input potion (sorry.)
Summon a familiar that is specialized in being aware of its surroundings, and helps to protect you and shield you from aggression in combat.
enchantment.artificers_armory.healer.des: Summon a familiar that has no offensive capabilities, but provides superior support to you and your allies.
Summon a familiar that has no direct offensive capabilities, but causes superior mischief among your enemies and can occasionally steal items.
enchantment.artificers_armory.bruiser.de: Summon a familiar that has superior offensive capabilities, but fewer supportive abilities.
enchantment.artificers_armory.pestilence: Plagued enemies will create plague rats that deal damage and spread infection.
enchantment.artificers_armory.ashes_ashe: Plagued enemies take increased damage over time and create a damaging cloud upon death.
enchantment.artificers_armory.delirium.d: Plagued enemies will become confused and move and attack other enemies randomly.
enchantment.artificers_armory.transmutat: Positive effects will inflict negative effects on enemies, and negative effects will inflict positive effects on you and allies. Converted effects have half the potency.
Incense clouds will slowly heal you and allies, and damage enemies.
Incense clouds last longer and affect a wider area.
effect.artificers_armory.soul_burn.descr: For entities that can be set on fire, this effect increases the amount of fire damage taken from burning by 1 per level. For entities immune to fire, it causes a damage over time effect similar to burning.
effect.artificers_armory.empowered.descr: This effect is given to undead servants by continually using a Spirit Candle item, and increases attack damage, movement speed, and armor points by a small amount, which scales with the tier of candle.
effect.artificers_armory.grim_harvest.de: This effect is given to undead servants when they or their master kill an enemy while holding a Spirit Candle with the Grim Harvest enchantment, and increases attack damage, movement speed, and armor points by a small amount, which scales with the tier of candle. Only activates when the holder of the spirit candle cannot have any more minions active.
effect.artificers_armory.blessing.descri: This effect is given by Chimes and Censers, and increases attack strength and damage negation. Higher tiered items provide higher levels of this effect.
effect.artificers_armory.plague.descript: This effect is inflicted by using a Blight, deals damage over time, and slows and weakens healing, attacks, and movement. Higher tiered items inflict higher levels of this effect.
effect.artificers_armory.pestilence.desc: This effect is inflicted by using a Blight with the Pestilence enchantment, and causes plagued enemies to occasionally create phantasmal plague rats that will hunt down uninfected enemies and damage and apply Plague to them.
effect.artificers_armory.black_death.des: This effect is inflicted by using a Blight with the Ashes, Ashes enchantment, and causes plagued enemies to take increased damage over time, and burst into a cloud of damaging toxin on death.
effect.artificers_armory.delirium.descri: This effect is inflicted by using a Blight with the Delirium enchantment, and causes plagued enemies to occasionally become confused and attack other enemies or move randomly. For players, the effect inflicts Nausea and causes random movement.
